info.name: Weather Underground PWS Forecast Location API

params.name: geocode
params.description: Latitude and longitude as a comma-separated pair

params.name: product
params.description: Product type to search for (use "pws" for Personal Weather Stations)

params.name: format
params.description: Response format. Only JSON is currently supported.

items.docs: Returns a list of nearest active Personal Weather Stations for a given geographic coordinate. Useful for discovering available station IDs before querying observation data.
